announcements.title: A favour before 2.0
announcements.body: Trenchcord 2.0 is nearly here, and with it a subscription. New people still have to decide whether to trust a crypto app with their Discord token — and your word does that far better than mine. Post a testimonial on Discord before August 24 for the OG role, plus a discount when subscriptions launch.

announcements.title: Trenchcord on iPhone?
announcements.body: We're voting on Discord: would you use Trenchcord on your iPhone? Everything would run locally on your phone, just like the desktop app. Cast your vote and help decide what gets built next.

announcements.title: Trenchcord 1.3.0 is out
announcements.body: Buy straight from a call: one-click Solana buy buttons under any contract, with the chart opening on click. Plus Telegram now reconnects on its own, and a security fix every self-hoster should take.

announcements.title: Trenchcord 1.2.0 is out
announcements.body: Pop-out chat windows now work in the browser, and Telegram bot DMs can finally be added to rooms. Update from the desktop app or grab the latest build.

announcements.title: Trenchcord 1.1.1 is out
announcements.body: Pop-out chat windows, automatic EVM chain detection, and proxy support for VPN users — plus fixes. Update from the desktop app or grab the latest build.

announcements.title: Join the Trenchcord Discord
announcements.body: Get updates, help, and downloads for the desktop app straight from our community.
